name: saffron
description: Write end-to-end UI tests in plain language with Saffron: an AI agent records each scenario once, every later run replays at zero tokens. Adds the saffron MCP server (search_steps, list_step_sets, project_status) and the Saffron agent skill.

interface.longDescription: Write .saffron and .feature tests in plain language. An AI agent records each scenario once and cached runs replay at zero tokens. The local MCP tools search your project's vocabulary, list StepSets and read project status so Codex can reuse recorded wordings. Requires Node.js 22.12 or later. Recording and healing require Playwright browsers and a configured AI provider; AI usage is charged to your own account. Runs locally and reads files in the current project. Codex receives the MCP server and authoring skill; the language server is available in Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Write a Saffron test for the login flow
Review the pending Saffron cache proposals
